periods.summary: Timid reunites with Ikki at the Vermillion castle after previously attacking him under Sirius' bounty order. Lunaeyes asks Ikki to train Timid and Milialia before the coming representative war because they are strong as a pair but individually vulnerable. During the Caldia operation Timid supports Ikki and Milialia on the ground. She uses Material Dive to enter road surfaces and even a tank, allowing her to seize marked relay-node soldiers who would otherwise be inaccessible. When B.B. destroys the helicopter, Timid uses Starry Sea to turn the road into a liquid-like surface and safely catch Ikki, Milialia, and the pilot.

key_events.summary: Is brought to Ikki for rapid tactical training.
Captures relay nodes inside roads and tanks using Material Dive.
Catches the falling helicopter survivors with Starry Sea.
